review_evidence: README states the project goal is to formalize expander graphs and related spectral graph theory.
Five of six Lean files contain proposition declarations, including normalized adjacency/Laplacian spectral facts, connectivity/Cheeger lemmas and the expander mixing lemma.
The development includes substantive completed theorems even though some later chapter targets remain marked sorry.
summary: Reviewed expander-graphs; retain the spectral graph theory formalization.
